# @ddsr/* — the TypeScript client of Fennec Services

Copied from `xdp-ui/vendor/ddsr` (emf.services `82e7f3b`, snapshot 2026-09-25) — the same four
tarballs xdp-ui uses, so that the views move over without a version change. The TypeScript track of
[emf.services](https://github.com/eclipse-fennec/emf.services) is not published to npm; how to
rebuild the tarballs is in xdp-ui's copy of this file.
